newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil federal tax receipts dip 0.18 pct in Nov.
newsitem.headline: Brazil federal tax receipts dip 0.18 pct in Nov.

text.p: Brazil's federal tax receipts dipped 0.18 percent in November to 7.886 billion reais, the National Tax Secretariat said on Thursday.
When adjusted for inflation, November receipts were 0.46 percent lower than the 7.9 billion reais raised in October.

Tax receipts for the January-November period totaled 87.017 billion reais, 11.02 percent higher in nominal terms than receipts in the same period last year, but down 0.26 percent when adjusted for inflation.

November brought a 21.51 percent increase over October in the amount of corporate tax raised, mainly because of payments by several financial institutions that had been challenging their contributions in court.
A tax collected on industrial output rose 9.04 percent from October, which had three fewer working days than November.
